test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.**

You have _________ (built up) a lot of muscles by going to the gym.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gained**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**built up**" means to increase or develop something, usually over time. (किसी चीज़ को बढ़ाना या विकसित करना)
 
• The synonym for "built up" in this context is "**gained**", which means to acquire or obtain something, often through effort or work. (किसी चीज़ को प्राप्त करना या हासिल करना, अक्सर प्रयास या काम के माध्यम से)
